verdict.gold_reason: Article 19(5) requires only TSOs performing the reserve replacement process that have at least one interconnected neighbouring TSO performing the replacement reserves process to implement and make operational the European platform for replacement reserves. The reference answer states exactly this.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is obfuscated ('back-up stage', 'exchange scheme'), but the neighbour-condition fits only Article 19(5). Articles 20 to 22 apply to all TSOs or to TSOs performing aFRP, with no neighbour condition.
